name: How should I choose a reliable home repair contractor?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a reliable home repair contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a repair contractor who operates as an established, insured business and provides hands-on oversight rather than handing work off to unvetted third parties. Checking for verified credentials, such as an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, gives confidence in their business practices. Ask whether the lead contractor works directly on site and how they coordinate trade work like plumbing or electrical. A reliable contractor provides clear written estimates, explains timelines upfront, and cleans up workspace debris daily.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an insured contractor with strong ratings, hands-on job site leadership, clear written scopes, and established coordination for mechanical sub-trades.
